stem.text: Which graph shows the relative melting points of the elements Mg, Al, Si and P plotted against their relative electronegativities?

A.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity with points for Mg, Al, Si and P: Al highest, P lowest

B.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity with points for Mg, Al, Si and P: Si highest, P lowest

C.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity with points for Mg, Al, Si and P: Si highest, P lowest

D.alt: Graph of melting point against electronegativity with points for Mg, Al, Si and P: Al highest, P lowest
